commentary_summary: Drewry's tonnemile index for Panamax vessels moderated for the second consecutive week but continues to be elevated YoY. | The tonnage underway in the East moderated last week from its historical peak but the share of laden tonnage in the region edged up. | Tonnage of approximately 7.5 mdwt is waiting at the anchor in the Pacific to unload cargo, the highest level attained in 2024 so far. The surge in US' grain exports to Japan and South Korea from the US West coast has been a significant contributor to the heightened activity in the region. | Additionally, the laden tonnage waiting at the anchor in China has reached its second-highest level in 2024 so far as coal and soybean imports remain buoyant.
